slides.headline: Glassdoor is anonymous.
slides.body: That makes repeat posting hard to spot from the outside.

slides.headline: The tells are in the writing.
slides.body: The same complaint, the same phrases, slightly different job titles.

slides.headline: They cluster.
slides.body: Usually within weeks of one difficult exit.

slides.headline: Small companies feel it most.
slides.body: With 20 reviews, five from one person can rewrite your rating.

slides.headline: Don't try to unmask them.
slides.body: Hunting for an anonymous reviewer can create legal exposure and looks terrible if it surfaces.

slides.headline: Send it to people who handle this instead.
Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
